Exercise 9. a) wazīratu l-ḫāriǧiyyati taǧtamiʿu maʿa s-safīri l-maġribīThe Minister of Foreign Affairs shall meet with the Moroccan Ambassador. b) al-ḥukūmatu tabnī mustašfan ǧadīdan fī l-BaṣraThe government builds a new hospital in Basra. ⁧الحكومة⁩ is female) · c) maṭāru Bayrūta yaʿūdu ilā l-ʿamalBeirut Airport is back in operation (he) · d) aš-šurṭatu tattaṣilu bi-ʿāʾilati s-sāʾiḥThe police contact the tourist's family (she) · e) aṭ-ṭullābu yabḥaṯūna ʿan sakanin fī Mīlānū: "Students are looking for accommodation in Milan" (them, m.). In e) ⁧سكن⁩ (sakan .) is a new word: it is derived from the root ⁧س ك ن⁩ ( A2-01). Exercise 11. a) Five years. b) It starts at 10:00 in the evening and ends at 6:00 in the morning. c) He wakes up in the afternoon, drinks a big coffee, walks a bit in the garden next to his house, at nine o'clock he wears his uniform and takes the subway. d) With a colleague named Paul: they drive out into the streets of the neighborhood and sometimes stop in front of the station. e) A tourist who lost his passport, a man who couldn't find his car, a woman who heard noises on the street. f) Listen, write and sometimes translate from Arabic to English. g) He doesn't see her, but he calls her every day. h) She doesn't like them, but at night the city is something else. i) Double: ⁧يَخْرُجَانِ⁩ , ⁧يَقِفَانِ⁩ · ⁧و⁩ Initial: ⁧يَقِفَانِ⁩ , ⁧يَجِدُ⁩ · concave: ⁧تَعُودُ⁩ , ⁧تَنَامُ⁩ , ⁧تَقُولُ⁩ · defects: ⁧تَمْشِي⁩ , ⁧يَأْتِي⁩ , ⁧تَنْتَهِي⁩ , ⁧تَرَى⁩ . Exercise 12. a) An Italian company in Milan. b) Arabic and Italian. c) Translate letters and reports, review colleagues' translations, contact customers in Egypt, Tunisia and Morocco. d) Twice. e) Full-time, from 9 to 17Monday to Friday. f) The salary is good, the experience is important. g) 0245678912. h) ⁧تُتَرْجِمُ⁩
⁧المُتَرْجِمَةُ الرَّسَائِلَ وَالتَّقَارِيرَ، وَتُرَاجِعُ تَرْجَمَاتِ الزُّمَلَاءِ، وَتَتَّصِلُ بِالعُمَلَاءِ⁩ … ⁧وَتُسَافِرُ مَرَّتَيْنِ فِي السَّنَةِ⁩ .
Exercise 13 · Model (week 2).
⁧أَعْمَلُ مِنْ يَوْمِ الاِثْنَيْنِ إِلَى يَوْمِ الجُمُعَةِ. أَسْتَيْقِظُ عَادَةً فِي السَّادِسَةِ وَالنِّصْفِ، وَأَشْرَبُ القَهْوَةَ دَائِمًا قَبْلَ العَمَلِ.⁩
⁧أَرْكَبُ الحَافِلَةَ، وَأَصِلُ إِلَى المَكْتَبِ فِي الثَّامِنَةِ. أَحْيَانًا أَتَأَخَّرُ، لِأَنَّ الحَافِلَةَ تَقِفُ كَثِيرًا. فِي المَكْتَبِ أَكْتُبُ⁩
⁧التَّقَارِيرَ، وَأَتَّصِلُ بِالمَحَاكِمِ، وَكَرِيم وَسَارَة يُتَرْجِمَانِ الرَّسَائِلَ العَرَبِيَّةَ. نَأْكُلُ غَالِبًا فِي مَطْعَمٍ قَرِيبٍ. يَوْمَ الثُّلَاثَاءِ⁩
⁧وَيَوْمَ الخَمِيسِ أَذْهَبُ إِلَى دَرْسِ العَرَبِيَّةِ، وَأَعُودُ إِلَى البَيْتِ فِي العَاشِرَةِ. نَادِرًا مَا أَطْبُخُ فِي المَسَاءِ. يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ⁩
⁧أَمْشِي فِي المَدِينَةِ وَأَشْتَرِي الجَرَائِدَ. لَا أَعْمَلُ يَوْمَ الأَحَدِ أَبَدًا: أَنَامُ حَتَّى العَاشِرَةِ!⁩

( 98 words.) ⁧نَادِرًا مَا أَطْبُخُ⁩ I rarely cook with: ⁧نَادِرًا⁩ is often used ⁧مَا⁩ without negative value; also ⁧أَطْبُخُ نَادِرًا⁩ That's correct. Exercise 14. a) He only drinks tea, never coffee. He wakes up at six, walks half an hour, takes the subway and arrives at the office at eight. He translates letters and reports, revises colleagues' translations and sometimes calls the consulates. Hudā He's on night shift. b) 1. I: I teach Arabic · 2. He never eats at the office: goes with Hudā in a small restaurant nearby. In the evening he calls his mother in Beirut; Saturdays rest and don't work.
